name: Evanston, Illinois

coverage.summary: Employers with 100 or more employees in hospitality (hotels with 7+ rooms), food service and restaurants, retail, warehouse, manufacturing or building services. Restaurants need at least 30 locations and 200 employees globally. Franchisees of a network with more than 30 locations are covered.
coverage.employees: Employees who work at least 2 hours a week in Evanston and are entitled to the Illinois minimum wage. There is no wage cap.

citation.quote: Employers shall post the Work Schedule no later than 14 days before the first day of any new Work Schedule.

premiums.label: Hours cut or shift cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours to the Employee: four hours or the number of hours in the Employee's scheduled Shift, whichever is less, when hours are canceled or reduced.

premiums.label: Hours added or shift moved with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours to the Employee: one hour of Predictability Pay for all other changes.

premiums.label: Any change with less than 14 days' but at least 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 14 days' notice, but 24 hours or more notice to the Employee: one hour of Predictability Pay.

An Employee who agrees in writing to work hours within 11 hours of the Employee's last Shift shall be compensated at one and one-half times the Employee's regular rate of pay for any hours worked less than 11 hours following the end of a previous shift.

exceptions.label: Work couldn't begin or continue
exceptions.description: Threats or civil authorities, a utility or sewer failure, acts of nature or weather that prohibits business operations, or war, civil unrest, strikes, threats to public safety or pandemics.

exceptions.label: Shift trade or coverage I agreed to with a coworker
exceptions.description: Mutually agreed shift trades or coverage between employees.

exceptions.label: I asked for this change, confirmed in writing
exceptions.description: An employee-requested change confirmed in writing.

exceptions.label: Hours cut for documented discipline
exceptions.description: Hours cut for just-cause discipline, documented in writing.

exceptions.label: I set my own schedule
exceptions.description: Employees who choose their own schedules.

otherRights.label: Right to decline hours within 11 hours of your last shift

sources.title: Evanston City Code Title 3, Ch. 34 (Fair Work Week)

notes: Ordinance 24-O-23 set an effective date of September 1, 2023; the city reportedly began enforcement on January 1, 2024.
Evanston's text has no small-change grace period, so every change of a minute or more counts.
Required extra hours during an exempt emergency earn $2.00 an hour in hazard pay (§ 3-34-5(D)(1)(e)); Shiftowed does not calculate this.
The rest premium is time and a half on the hours inside the 11-hour window. Shiftowed shows the extra half-time.
